blocks.text: BUTUAN CITY, Agusan del Norte — Science and Technology Secretary Renato Solidum Jr. has challenged local startups, universities, and local governments to move beyond simply launching new ventures and focus instead on scaling up, commercializing research, and building “future-proof” enterprises. Delivering the keynote message at the 10th National Technology Business Incubation (TBI) Summit at the Watergate Hotel here on Friday, Nov. 13, Solidum emphasized that world-class innovation is not exclusive to Metro Manila and must be anchored on regional strengths. “Talent is everywhere; opportunity should be, too,” Solidum told delegates, noting that solutions grounded in local capabilities—from crops and coastlines to […]...
